question: Should Control UI plugin artwork permanently use an authenticated Gateway endpoint that resolves plugin metadata and performs bounded outbound image fetches?
rationale: Tests can validate mechanics, but they cannot choose whether plugin/catalog metadata should gain this new Gateway-controlled network-fetch capability and browser SVG normalization boundary.

options.title: Approve after diagnostic proof
options.body: Accept the identity-keyed proxy design after a redacted live trace proves authentication, same-origin loading, SSRF rejection, and fallback behavior on the rebased head.

options.title: Narrow the artwork contract
options.body: Restrict supported artwork to bundled assets or pre-normalized raster content if maintainers do not want runtime Gateway fetches or browser SVG parsing.

options.title: Defer remote catalog artwork
options.body: Keep monograms and bundled artwork until a different catalog asset-distribution architecture is selected.

recommendation.title: Approve after diagnostic proof
recommendation.body: Accept the identity-keyed proxy design after a redacted live trace proves authentication, same-origin loading, SSRF rejection, and fallback behavior on the rebased head.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent history most directly covers authenticated Control UI HTTP route authorization and therefore the boundary this PR extends.
